{{Top|leg}}
The '''Dyne 427 radial atomizer engine''' was a type of [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight engine]] that was used in [[KR-TB "Doomtreader"]] [[starship]]s, such as  ''[[Hell's Anvil]]''. The "Doomtreader" model featured two aft-mounted Dyne 427 engines.<ref name="BHSG">[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Bounty Hunter'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>
